releases.notes:
Native Metal antialiasing for Minecraft on Apple Silicon.

- Quality temporal AA, including stationary-edge and thin-line stability fixes.
- Lightweight Performance mode.
- Settings via F8, rebindable controls, or Mod Menu.

Download **anodic-0.jar** and replace any older Anodic JAR in your mods folder.

Requires Minecraft **26.2**, Metallum **0.0.23**, Fabric Loader **0.19.3+**, and Java **25+**.

Quality remains experimental; extremely thin geometry and moving objects can shimmer or trail. Native Metal regression tests and Sodium 0.9.1 smoke checks passed. See VALIDATION.md for details.
